description_en: Retrieves the configurations of an accelerated domain name. You can query the configurations of multiple features in a single call
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnDomainConfigs获取加速域名的配置信息，一次可查询多个功能配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-cdn-domain-configs --domain-name example.com --function-names aliauth --config-id 6295 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCdnDomainConfigs

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can query only one domain name at a time
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，仅支持查询单个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The names of the features. Separate multiple feature names with commas (,). For more information about feature names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388460.html
parameters.help_zh: 功能函数名称，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。更多功能名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388460.html
parameters.name: function_names

parameters.help_en: The ID of the feature configuration. For more information about how to query and use a ConfigId, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388994.html
parameters.help_zh: 功能配置ID。ConfigId查询和使用，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388994.html
parameters.name: config_id

FunctionArg.description_en: The parameter settings for each feature
FunctionArg.description_zh: 各个功能函数所对应的参数配置

ArgName.description_en: The parameter name. This is a configuration item of functionName. You can configure multiple configuration items
ArgName.description_zh: 参数名称，functionName的配置项（可配置多个配置项）

ArgValue.description_en: The parameter value. This is the value of the configuration item for functionName
ArgValue.description_zh: 参数值，functionName的配置项的取值

ParentId.description_en:
The ID of the rule condition. This parameter is optional.

You can create a rule condition by configuring the condition feature (rules engine) in [Parameters for domain name configurations]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388460.html）. A rule condition can match and filter user requests by detecting various parameters in the requests. After a rule condition is created, a corresponding [ConfigId]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388994.html） is generated. The ConfigId can be referenced by other features as the ParentId parameter. This way, you can combine rule conditions and feature configurations to create more flexible configurations.

For more information about the configuration procedure, see [Configure domain names in batches]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/90915.html） or the ParentId configuration example in this topic
ParentId.description_zh:
规则条件ID，非必填项。

通过配置[域名配置功能参数]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388460.html）中的功能函数**condition**（规则引擎），可以创建出规则条件（规则条件可以通过识别用户请求中携带的各种参数来匹配和过滤用户请求），每一个规则条件被创建以后都会生成一个对应的[ConfigId]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388994.html），ConfigId可以被当作ParentId参数被其他功能函数引用，这样规则条件就可以与功能配置一起组合形成更灵活的配置。

具体配置操作请参考[批量配置域名]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/90915.html）或下文ParentId配置示例说明

Status.description_en:
The status of the configuration. Valid values:

success: The configuration is successful.

testing: The configuration is being tested.

failed: The configuration failed.

configuring: The configuration is in progress
Status.description_zh:
配置状态。取值：

success：成功。

testing：测试中。

failed：失败。

configuring：配置中
